propositions: A new peer-confirmation record store must persist vendor link metadata (link_id, direction, pass_id, source, confirmed_at) keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) to distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones in the inbound removal path

The outbound link dispatch flow must invoke a callback after successful set_relationship to record confirmation, passing link_id extracted from the backend response (or null if absent), without failing the outbound link or perturbing link counters
Unbound targets (where binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must skip confirmation recording entirely rather than persisting vendor keys in local-id fields

The peer_confirmations.json file must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames so confirmation-only changes are committed despite the per-file idempotency guard in _commit_binding_store_snapshot
Confirmation write failures and corrupt/absent store files must be fail-open (logged, swallowed, degrading to unconfirmed state) without aborting the reconciliation pass
The link_confirm callback parameter must preserve existing dispatch behavior byte-for-byte when None is passed, with identical link counter values across success, failure, and dedup-skip paths
